root_idea.summary: The root denotes the gathering and compacting of one thing upon another.
root_idea.development: Its lexical development extends from compacted accumulations to foundations, collected paper, and strings of beads. The noun كُرْسِيّ denotes a seat or support and develops figurative applications, while derived verbs describe placing, consolidation, and concealment.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The single Quran-attested nominal group is displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic citation form كُرْسِيّ.

senses.definition: A seat, chair, throne, or footstool.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an object made for sitting, including a royal seat. In one traditional interpretation of 2:255, it denotes God's footstool or place of the feet.

senses.definition: The divine dominion, power, or encompassing knowledge signified by the Kursī.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the extended interpretation of the divine Kursī in 2:255, where traditional explanations include God's dominion, His power over the heavens and earth, or His knowledge. Another interpretation identifies it with a cosmic sphere.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A compacted or caked mass of camel, sheep, or goat dung and urine; also compacted clay or mud, especially as hardened ground at a watering place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of compacted material in houses, traces of human habitation, and the ground at a watering place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foundation or lowest part of a building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A building term referring to its compacted base.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One series or string of beads in a necklace or similar ornament, joined to another series.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the several connected bead-series of necklaces and comparable ornaments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The original base or core of a thing; by extension, any gathered or aggregated whole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A generalized Classical usage for something regarded as collected or constituting a basic mass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place one part upon another; to assemble or establish a building foundation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; used both of physical layering and of founding a building.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a house, place, or beast of carriage: to have dung and urine compacted in or upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV; for a place, the compacted material is within it, and for a beast it may be upon its tail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become piled one part upon another, compacted, and coherent; of a building foundation, to become hard and strong; also, to collect firewood together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V; the subject may be a material, a building foundation, or collected fuel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter into a thing and conceal oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VII construction with فِي and an object entered into.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People of learning or science; learned men, by an elliptical figurative use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative and elliptical social designation derived from the association of the seat with a king or learned person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prop or support for a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A building-support usage distinct from the ordinary seat sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A privy on the roof of a house or in an upper chamber, with a conduit leading downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is restricted to an upper privy; a lower one is not so called.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quire or parcel of paper, a portion of a book or volume, generally consisting of five sheets or ten leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A unit or portion of a written book, named for its being gathered or compacted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large-headed person or thing, as though the parts of the head were densely joined together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive derivative based on the notion of compact assembly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Traces of human habitation containing a compacted mixture of camel, sheep, or goat dung and urine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of the compacted remains at an abandoned dwelling site.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necklace whose beads are strung on two threads joined by divisions of larger beads; also a string of beads arranged one above another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bead-ornament construction involving layered or joined strings.
A specialized term for the setting or supporting rim of the ring.
A plant or pulse name, also reported with a variant pronunciation or spelling.

cautions: The divine Kursī in 2:255 has several explicitly reported traditional interpretations, including a seat or footstool, dominion or power, knowledge, and a cosmic sphere; these are retained as interpretive alternatives within the Quranic entry rather than treated as unrelated ordinary nouns.
